general.description:
This planet was the cradleworld of the sentient species currently called Purgatorians. They seems to have disapeared some 5500 years before the first of the current major spacegoing species set up to space.
When the Ashioto ("Footsteps") system was first explored by Humans, several Policorpos engaged in a very dirty war to get a hand on the powerful technological remnants lying on the planet. They used tactical atomics, heavy cyborgization, highly illegal hypnotics and endoctrination, and even dared to use recovered purgatorian technologies they did not fully understand, ending up with a number of local cataclysms. The name "Purgatoire" itself was coined by the suffering troops on all sides of that merciless war.
During the conflict, an overwhelming number of soldiers revolted over the years. They formed an independent army that allied with Harushita, the cleanest of the policorpos engaged on the main war. They forcibly struck a general cease-fire, then a peace among the expeditionary forces. Later on, Harushita joined the then-secret Planetarist Alliance to defeat the other policorpos, whom they thought had failed to keep their honour and integrity, and the Purgatoire Irregulars became the core of the Alliance Military.
Over the course of history, a number of further incidents involved all species with runaway purgatorian techs recovered from various places, nearly always ending in disaster. K'Rinn research teams also demonstrated that the Purgatorians were the Til'kk'Rantk, the "Flying Gods" who once visited H'Rkann millenia ago. They were responsible for the flawed gengineering made on the Ha'Tinkar, that ended up with that innocent people being wiped out by a terrible disease a few years after they encountered the K'Rinns.
Currently, the planet is under protectorate from the ad-hoc Ashioto Cluster council that was formed for managing the technological remnants studies without taking further risks of catastrophs. It is basically a joint organisation between the Central League and the K'Rinn Council, with other States being represented through Commonwealth Delegates. They are helping to relocate the freed ex-slaves and fooled scavengers wanting to quit the scorched planet. It is, too the setting of an emerging movement of reforestation and depollution of the planet, with the help of locals peoples and movements like the Free Gardeners or the Daneb anarchs.
general.bar: People from the continent trading good from goods from the planet for goods from outer-space : Baiole's silk, recycled materials, etc... for electronics components, seeds of bridges species, etc... Nearly all, even Ziffelian Dragons can be found, except, of course, Purgatorian's artefacts. Ashioto Cluster guards and agents are watching. At the bar, now more than the original 3 campings-tables it was, besides the scientists, Steppes' Nomads stands alongside spacers, Bounty Hunters chasing HeadHunters, Free Gardeners and Adrimai waiting for friends from outer space, liberated ex-slaves and ex-scavengers quitting the planet for a far better place, etc... All people enjoying purified water, Sand-Cider and Baikumis.
